sections.heading: The commitments sheet
sections.lead: W5. Opened from the Home header. Three tabs for a steward, two for a member; every row leads into its garden.

frames.title: Home, header badge
frames.caption: Seven things waiting: six of the steward's own acts plus one the garden must confirm. The badge counts every tab of the sheet.

frames.title: Live
frames.caption: Grouped by garden, what needs you first. State chip and marker under the words.

frames.title: Live, scrolled
frames.caption: Rows that need nothing sit after the ones that do.

frames.title: Over time
frames.caption: Settled: kept, withdrawn, lapsed.

frames.title: To confirm (stewards only)
frames.caption: What reaches you through the garden's Hat, never a Live row twice. Each row says whether it is a garden claim or a recorded commitment.

frames.title: The same sheet as a member
frames.caption: mockAuth=user: two tabs, no To confirm.

sections.heading: The garden pool
sections.lead: W1. The Pool tab of Green Goods Community Garden: the cycle rail, the charter line, direction chips, the rows, and the floating doors.

frames.title: Pool tab
frames.caption: Spring 2026 (2 of 6 kept) and the Community work day campaign on the rail, then the rows.

frames.title: Pool rows
frames.caption: Withdrawn, lapsed, kept, all still readable in the pool's own list.

frames.title: Two doors
frames.caption: The floating entry opens Offer and Request over a scrim; the direction is fixed by the door.

frames.title: A queued creation
frames.caption: A commitment composed on this phone rides the top of the list: Waiting to send, saved on this phone.

frames.title: A paused pool (Growecosystems)
frames.caption: The stewards' reason, resolved from its CID, above an otherwise empty pool.

sections.heading: Composing an offer
sections.lead: W3. Four beats: what, how much, details, review. Every field persists as a draft on the device and resumes after a restart.

frames.title: What
frames.caption: Garden work or a service; where it runs (one open season and one campaign, so a chooser); a name.

frames.title: How much
frames.caption: Hours, by when, and the garden's own actions as requirement rows, each with its count.

frames.title: Details
frames.caption: Who confirms, fallback and open team, a note and links.

frames.title: Review
frames.caption: Every answer in sections, the consequence in words, the queued note, then Make this offer once read to the end.

frames.title: Placed
frames.caption: Queued on this phone; it sends when connected.

frames.title: Resume your draft?
frames.caption: Reopening the door after a reload offers the saved draft by name.

sections.heading: One commitment, by seat
sections.lead: W2. The same screen reads differently from every seat: status band first, then identity, people, team, progress, work, and the one act in the bar.

frames.title: A neighbour's open offer
frames.caption: Bystander: Take this up.

frames.title: Your own open offer
frames.caption: Provider before anyone takes it: Withdraw, with a required reason that is pinned before the call.

frames.title: Leading garden work
frames.caption: Part of this is approved; note and link from the metadata; people with You.

frames.title: Team, progress, work
frames.caption: Lead and assigned rows, per-action progress never summed, the linked work, and Add proof with Link work beneath it.

frames.title: Link work
frames.caption: A picker of your approved work in this garden and the row it fulfils.

frames.title: An act already queued
frames.caption: After adding proof the bar is held: your last act here is waiting to send from this phone.

frames.title: An open team
frames.caption: A bystander may join; joining earns no credit by itself.

frames.title: Kept by a steward stepping in
frames.caption: Provenance names who confirmed, by which path, and the reason on record.

frames.title: Lapsed
frames.caption: The season moved on; Offer it again.

frames.title: The Work screen's Fulfills row
frames.caption: WFLOW: read from the indexer's attribution, navigable to the commitment, never editable.

sections.heading: Adding proof
sections.lead: W2a. Media, who did this, review. Photos and voice notes stay on the phone and publish at sync; the commitment then shows the act as waiting.

frames.title: Media
frames.caption: Tap to add, camera, gallery, voice note.

frames.title: Media attached
frames.caption: Two photos, each drawn as the picture itself.

frames.title: Who did this
frames.caption: Credit is a labelled choice over the active roster; the signed-in member is preselected.

frames.title: Review
frames.caption: What is attached, the words, who is credited, and what adding it does.

frames.title: Queued
frames.caption: On its way; it appears on the commitment once it lands.

sections.heading: Confirming, and Not yet
sections.lead: W4. The sheet asks the cast's own question and offers two answers. Not yet takes a reason and raises a dispute; it never cancels anything.

frames.title: Ready for you to confirm
frames.caption: The confirmer's view of a support offer they took up.

frames.title: Commitment kept? (support)
frames.caption: Summary, proof count, the confirmation meter, the exclusion rule, two answers.

frames.title: Not yet
frames.caption: Reason chips, the words, and what sending does.

frames.title: Was the work you asked for done?
frames.caption: Garden work you asked for: the approved-work row joins the proof row.

frames.title: A named group
frames.caption: Any 2 of the named people; 1 of 2 so far; Your turn.

frames.title: Recorded for someone
frames.caption: A steward recorded it for a neighbour; they remain the source, you confirm it.

frames.title: A garden's claim, as its steward
frames.caption: The garden took the offer up; its steward confirms for it, as the contract seats them.

sections.heading: Asking to take something up
sections.lead: W1 + W25. Steward-reviewed requests in their exact lifecycle, and the provider-context choice on the protocol pool.

frames.title: Declined
frames.caption: The steward's reason from its CID, and a fresh Ask again.

frames.title: Taken up by another
frames.caption: Nothing failed, nothing to retry; Back to the pool.

frames.title: Who takes this up
frames.caption: On the protocol pool: as yourself by default; a garden option appears only for that garden's stewards.

sections.heading: The Garden's public record
sections.lead: /gardens/:id § 02, “Commitments between neighbours”. One editorial panel under a canvas header, carrying the pool state, lifetime made and kept, the open cycles beside their unit rows, and the finished history. Cancelled cycles, pause reasons, provider rows and addresses never appear here. Each frame shows the panel at 1280 and at 390.

frames.title: Record
frames.caption: The whole record at once: the pool-state sentence beside lifetime made and kept, the open Season and the open Campaign beside the pool-wide unit rows, finished cycles newest first, and the line tying fulfilled commitments to the certificates.

frames.title: CountsOnly
frames.caption: A young pool. Plenty of commitments, but between too few people to publish a rate, so the panel shows counts and no percentage anywhere.

frames.title: BetweenSeasons
frames.caption: No live cycle. The lifetime aggregates and the finished history carry the section, and it still has something true to say.

frames.title: EmptyOpenSeason
frames.caption: An open Season with nothing in it yet says so, and still names itself and its dates.

frames.title: EmptyPool
frames.caption: An open pool where nothing has been made. The empty note stands exactly where the numbers would be, rather than a row of zeroes.

frames.title: Ready
frames.caption: Charter and baseline in place, first Season not yet seeded. Readiness copy keeps the same panel rather than hiding it.

frames.title: PreLaunch
frames.caption: No pool registered yet. This is also what all eighteen local pools render as today, since every one of them is still NOT_READY.

frames.title: Paused
frames.caption: A quiet period. The line is neutral, the aggregates stay, and the pause reason is never published on the editorial surface.

frames.title: Closed
frames.caption: A closed pool keeps its history on the record. Closing never removes what was kept.

frames.title: Composted
frames.caption: Composted, ready for the next Season, record intact.

frames.title: MissingCycleName
frames.caption: A cycle whose metadata could not be resolved keeps its row. The window and the counts are known even when the name is not.

frames.title: ReadError
frames.caption: Unknown is not zero. The read failed, so every figure is an em dash, with a retry scoped to this section alone.

frames.title: Loading
frames.caption: The page is still resolving the Garden, and the section waits with it instead of flashing an empty state.

sections.heading: The protocol band
sections.lead: /impact § 02, “Work that starts as a commitment kept.” Four markers in the proof-marker grammar of § 01: Gardens with open pools, lifetime commitments fulfilled, the share kept, and CCIP-confirmed G$ support. A failed source renders an em dash, never a zero.

frames.title: Live
frames.caption: Above the publication threshold, so the one sanctioned percentage appears: commitments kept over commitments due.

frames.title: CountsOnly
frames.caption: Three of four due. Below the threshold, the band drops to counts and shows no percentage anywhere.

frames.title: CountsOnlyFewProviders
frames.caption: Enough commitments this time, but too few distinct providers for a rate to describe anyone fairly. Counts only again.

frames.title: NothingYet
frames.caption: Before any pool opens. Readiness phrasing throughout, never a live zero.

frames.title: PartialRead
frames.caption: Only the settlement read failed. Its marker dashes and the other three stand.

frames.title: Unavailable
frames.caption: Every source failed: four em dashes and the partial notice, with nothing invented to fill the gap.

sections.heading: Setting the pool up
sections.lead: W11. The steward's first run, and every later Season and Campaign, through one resumable write chain. Each step is judged against chain reads before and after sending, so a retry repeats only the call that did not land.

frames.title: Who the console is for
frames.caption: The gate before any of this: a member who is not a steward is told where to read the pool instead, and given nothing to press. The story is named for the unregistered cast, but the permission gate is checked first and its identity is not a steward, so this is what it renders.

frames.title: First run
frames.caption: The four-step flow: how, then the cycle, then the split, then open. Later intents start further in.

frames.title: How it works here
frames.caption: The charter sentence the garden publishes, and the cap on how many commitments one person can hold open.

frames.title: Naming the season
frames.caption: Name and window. The name is pinned as a document before the seed call, so the record can resolve it later.

frames.title: Second season blocked
frames.caption: One Season at a time. The guard names the season already running rather than failing at the write.

frames.title: The six-role split
frames.caption: How a kept commitment's recognition divides. Presets first, with the treasury floor called out.

frames.title: A split that does not sum
frames.caption: It must total 100%. Caught in the editor, before anything is sent.

frames.title: Review, then send
frames.caption: The last read before the ordered writes go out.

frames.title: Partly landed
frames.caption: The failure that matters most: it names what already landed on chain, and the retry sends only the rest.

sections.heading: The pool console
sections.lead: W7. /garden/pool in the Garden workspace. Summary, cycles, claims and commitments on the left; the pool's status and its lifecycle acts in the right rail. Stewards only.

frames.title: Where it lives
frames.caption: The Pool tab's place in the Garden workspace: the garden switcher, the tab rail, the bottom nav. The panel itself is bare here because the route story seeds the shell but not the chain-availability gate the console checks first — the populated console is the next frame.

frames.title: The console, open
frames.caption: The same tab with a pool behind it: summary, cycles, claims and commitments down the left, status and lifecycle acts in the right rail.

frames.title: Status, open
frames.caption: The chip, the charter sentence, the cap, and the acts a steward can take from here.

frames.title: Season and campaigns
frames.caption: The Season slot with campaigns as peers beside it, each with exactly one act.

frames.title: Open commitments
frames.caption: Search, then Open · Confirmed · Past. Rows open in the left inspector.

frames.title: Past due
frames.caption: Past due is a filter, not a state: a row stays live until the chain says Expired.

frames.title: Queued offline
frames.caption: Creations waiting on a connection sit above the indexed rows rather than disappearing.

frames.title: Claims waiting
frames.caption: Requests to take something up, keyed to the stored claimant. Accept is direct; decline needs a reason.

frames.title: Pausing, with a reason
frames.caption: Every reasoned act pins its reason as a document before the call. Suggestion chips, not a required essay.

frames.title: Status, paused
frames.caption: While paused the acts that would add to the pool are absent, not disabled. Evidence, cancel and resolve stay.

frames.title: Closing
frames.caption: Close is offered only when nothing is live. The dialog states the zero counts it is relying on.

sections.heading: Seeding a commitment
sections.lead: W8. /garden/pool/seed. The member composer recast for a steward, with the extras a steward has: named confirmers, a threshold, and a declared reward rail.

frames.title: What it is
frames.caption: Kind, direction, and which cycle it belongs to, grouped Season then Campaigns then cycle-less.

frames.title: How much
frames.caption: Unit label, target, due window, and the garden-work actions that will credit it.

frames.title: Who confirms it
frames.caption: A named group with a threshold, and the Green Goods team as the fallback when the ordinary path cannot be reached.

frames.title: The reward rail
frames.caption: Rails are exclusive and declared up front. Celo settlement carries its own explanation.

frames.title: Review
frames.caption: Sectioned, so the steward reads back exactly what will be created.

frames.title: In the protocol pool
frames.caption: The same composer opened from Community, where claims default to approval-gated.

sections.heading: One commitment, inspected
sections.lead: W10. /garden/pool/:commitmentId, a route-backed left sheet in the Garden workspace and a dialog everywhere else. Summary, alerts, facts, recovery, claims, timeline, then the acts.

frames.title: The record
frames.caption: Everything known about one commitment, in the order a steward reads it.

frames.title: The ordinary path is unreachable
frames.caption: The condition that unlocks a fallback confirmation, stated before the act appears.

frames.title: Under review
frames.caption: A raised dispute changes what the panel offers, and says so at the top.

frames.title: Recovery
frames.caption: An accepted commitment that needs an assessment attached before it can be marked ready.

frames.title: Sending for confirmation
frames.caption: Acts are separate and each is reasoned; none of them share a button.

frames.title: Confirming as the garden
frames.caption: The fallback names whose authority is being used, and requires a reason.

frames.title: Resolving a dispute
frames.caption: Four outcomes, filtered by where the reader actually stands.

sections.heading: The confirm stage
sections.lead: W13. /hub/confirm. Everything waiting on this steward, with the count carried on the Hub rail. Ordinary rows confirm in place; fallback rows open the record first.

frames.title: Confirm in the cockpit
frames.caption: The stage's place in the Hub, beside Work, Certify and History. The route story seeds the shell and not the queue, so what it shows is the empty stage; the seeded queue is next.

frames.title: The queue
frames.caption: Progress against the threshold on every row, and an eligibility badge that decides which act is offered.

frames.title: Nothing to confirm
frames.caption: The empty stage, distinct from the copy shown when a search matches nothing.

sections.heading: The protocol pool
sections.lead: W12. /community/pools. Exactly two tabs: the protocol pool the Green Goods team runs, and a way back into this garden's own. Never another garden's pool.

frames.title: Pools in the cockpit
frames.caption: The Community workspace in its Pools mode. Same caveat as the other two shells: seeded for the frame, not for the pool inside it.

frames.title: Two tabs, never three
frames.caption: Protocol pool and This garden, and nothing else — a steward never browses another garden's pool from here. Below the rail this story falls to the same steward gate as the first frame, so what the protocol console itself looks like is the pool console frames above, in the community tone.
